units.description: fahrenheit or celsius. Changes the API request, not just the label.

timer_alarm_seconds.description: How long a finished timer keeps sounding. Long enough to hear from another room, short enough that one nobody is near stops on its own. 0 turns the sound off and leaves the panel.

alarm_ring_seconds.description: How long an alarm keeps ringing. Longer than a timer's: a timer is answered by somebody standing over it, and an alarm by somebody who has to wake up first. 0 turns the sound off.

alarm_give_up_after.description: How long an unanswered alarm stays up before it clears itself. One nobody is near should not still be ringing when they get home.
